We have a Requirement UI Developer position in Denver CO, Conway, El Paso, Anywhere - Remote. If you have any matching resumes for the below mentioned position.

 

VERY URGENT AND IMMEDIATE NEED

 

Job Title: UI Developer

Location: Denver CO, Conway, El Paso, Anywhere - Remote

Duration: 12+ Months Contract

 

Healthcare Domain

 

Job Description:

 

Job Qualifications: Developer III CCM UI Developer, General

• College degree preferred or equivalent work experience.

• Minimum 6 years recent work experience in web technologies.

• Experience in healthcare industry.

• Experience in these technologies required: ASP.NET, C#, Javascript, NET Web Services and Oracle

• Experience in these technologies helpful: Java, CSS, XML processing, .NET Ajax Toolkit, iText, PDF processing ASP, and SQL.

• Experience with Systems development life cycle.

• Strong analytical skills.

• Strong communication skills .

Job Specific Skills/Special Functions:

• Ability to work with Web development tools for new applications.

• Basic Understanding of RDBMS databases such SQL Server and Oracle. Basic understanding of modern software design and development methodologies (e.g., OO).

 

Job Qualifications developer/TFAL (technical functional leader)

Three (3) years’ or more technical development leadership experience working with an implementation team of application developer required.

Prior experience working with MMIS or other healthcare systems required.

Five (5) years’ or more development experience with the following application developer tools is preferred: i.e., C, UNIX (HPUX, AIX, Linux, Solaris), PLSQL, and Oracle.

Typically a technical Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience and a minimum of 6 years’ experience or a Master’s degree and a minimum of 4 years of experience.

Work closely with State project teams providing them with sub system expertise needed for particular projects.

Solid understanding of the System Development Life-Cycle (SDLC).

 

Provide business expertise for the development and implementation of MMIS systems within the specific functional area assigned.

Basic understanding of modern software design and development methodologies (e.g., OO).

Experience on one or more full release project life cycles.

Strong understanding of modern SCM (software configuration management).

Basic understanding of testing tools and unit and integration test scripting, and testing methodologies.

Experience using an Integrated Development Environment (e.g., Eclipse, Visual Studio).

Strong understanding basic Database Administration.

Able to apply consistently quality and security standards.

Good verbal and written communication skills.

Developing general project management/team leader skills.

Ability to work effectively in a team and with clients.
